measure: Minimum tax on discretionary trusts

legislation: Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 3) Bill 2026 and Income Tax Rates Amendment (Minimum Tax on Discretionary Trusts) Bill 2026
review_scope: ATO summary and the stage source in stage_source_url; not a search of every draft or instrument
application_note: Check eligibility, commencement, application and transition provisions separately. Parliament's summaries of both bills give a 30 per cent minimum tax on the net income of discretionary trusts from 1 July 2028; the ATO measure page gives restructure roll-over relief from 1 July 2027. The explanatory memorandum applies the minimum tax to income years starting on or after 1 July 2028 (paragraph 1.98) and gives the roll-over for 3 years from 1 July 2027 (paragraph 2.1). The rates bill's page (bId r7555) shows the same stages.
bill_stage: Third reading agreed in the House 29 October 2026; Senate Economics Legislation Committee report due 13 November 2026
